title: Know your numbers
headline: Know your *numbers*
sub: Your morning at a glance, and how the week did.

recap.en: It is Friday morning. How did the week go?
recap.pcm: Na Friday morning. How the week go?

flow.action: Sips a cup of tea at her cutting table while reading her phone, and her eyebrows lift as the numbers appear; she smiles
flow.setting: Zuri Atelier workroom, Surulere: a bright room, a cutting table with bolts of Ankara in indigo, gold and green, two sewing machines, a rack of finished outfits in plastic covers, a mirror with a fitting platform, a window on a yellow-painted wall

flow.action: Looks up from her phone with a quiet proud smile and nods once
flow.setting: Zuri Atelier workroom, Surulere: a bright room, a cutting table with bolts of Ankara in indigo, gold and green, two sewing machines, a rack of finished outfits in plastic covers, a mirror with a fitting platform, a window on a yellow-painted wall

bridge.en: The week is going well. But money is moving. How does Zainab keep it safe?
bridge.pcm: The week dey go well. But money dey move. How Zainab go keep am safe?

en: Money in, against a usual Thursday.
Sales by the hour show when it came in.
Orders today, and what is waiting.
Under Needs you: one to approve, one to match.
She taps How we did this week.
Up seventeen percent on last week.
pcm: Every morning, Zainab dey open Today.
Money wey don enter, against usual Thursday.
Sales by the hour show when e enter.
Orders today, and wetin dey wait.
Under Needs you: one to approve, one to match.
She tap How we did this week.
Up seventeen percent on last week.
